<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>CRAFT07 | Official Minecraft Server</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;600;800&family=VT323&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        body {
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            color: #ffffff;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            position: relative;
            background: #09070f;
        }

        /* Background layer with new lantern image */
        .bg-layer {
            position: fixed;
            top: -10%; left: -10%;
            width: 120%; height: 120%;
            background: url('data:image/jpeg;base64,') no-repeat center center/cover;
            filter: blur(6px) brightness(0.55) saturate(1.3);
            z-index: -2;
            animation: bgDrift 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes bgDrift {
            0%   { transform: scale(1.05) translate(0px, 0px); }
            50%  { transform: scale(1.08) translate(-6px, -4px); }
            100% { transform: scale(1.05) translate(4px, 3px); }
        }

        /* Warm ambient glow matching lantern vibe */
        .ambient-glow {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background:
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 60%, rgba(255, 90, 30, 0.18) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 40%, rgba(180, 60, 255, 0.15) 0%, transparent 55%),
                radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 80%, rgba(255, 120, 0, 0.10) 0%, transparent 50%);
            z-index: -1;
            animation: glowPulse 6s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes glowPulse {
            0%   { opacity: 0.7; }
            50%  { opacity: 1.0; }
            100% { opacity: 0.8; }
        }

        /* Floating particles */
        .particles {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .particle {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            animation: floatUp linear infinite;
            opacity: 0;
        }

        @keyframes floatUp {
            0%   { transform: translateY(100vh) translateX(0px) scale(0); opacity: 0; }
            10%  { opacity: 0.7; }
            80%  { opacity: 0.4; }
            100% { transform: translateY(-10vh) translateX(30px) scale(1.2); opacity: 0; }
        }

        /* Glass Card */
        .glass-card {
            background: rgba(10, 5, 20, 0.45);
            backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(180%);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 160, 80, 0.18);
            border-radius: 28px;
            padding: 3rem 2rem;
            width: 92%;
            max-width: 460px;
            text-align: center;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            box-shadow:
                0 30px 70px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7),
                0 0 40px rgba(255, 80, 20, 0.12),
                inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 200, 100, 0.12);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            animation: cardEntrance 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both;
        }

        @keyframes cardEntrance {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px) scale(0.97); }
            to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0)   scale(1); }
        }

        /* Logo */
        .logo-frame {
            position: relative;
            margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
            width: 130px;
            height: 130px;
            border-radius: 24px;
            border: 1px solid #4248BD;
            box-shadow:
                0 0 25px rgba(178, 81, 255, 0.6),
                0 0 50px rgba(178, 81, 255, 0.2);
            overflow: hidden;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
            animation: logoFloat 4s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes logoFloat {
            0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0px);   box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(178,81,255,0.6), 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); }
            50%       { transform: translateY(-6px);  box-shadow: 0 0 35px rgba(178,81,255,0.8), 0 16px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); }
        }

        .server-logo {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            object-fit: cover;
            transition: transform 0.4s ease;
        }

        .logo-frame:hover .server-logo { transform: scale(1.06); }

        h1 {
            font-size: 2.8rem;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 30%, #ffb060 70%, #d494ff 100%);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            animation: titleShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
            background-size: 200% 200%;
        }

        @keyframes titleShimmer {
            0%   { background-position: 0% 50%; }
            50%  { background-position: 100% 50%; }
            100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
        }

        .sub-tag {
            font-family: 'VT323', monospace;
            font-size: 1.4rem;
            color: #ffaa55;
            margin-bottom: 2rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            opacity: 0.85;
        }

        /* Section titles */
        .section-title {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1.5px;
            color: #c0b0b0;
            align-self: flex-start;
            margin: 0.6rem 0 0.5rem 4px;
        }

        .block-emoji {
            width: 22px;
            height: 22px;
            object-fit: contain;
            border-radius: 4px;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .section-title:hover .block-emoji { transform: rotate(10deg) scale(1.15); }

        /* IP Showcase boxes */
        .ip-showcase {
            width: 100%;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            border-radius: 14px;
            padding: 1rem;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            margin-bottom: 1rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: background 0.35s ease, border-color 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease, transform 0.25s ease;
        }

        .ip-showcase:hover {
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            border-color: rgba(255, 130, 60, 0.45);
            box-shadow: 0 0 22px rgba(255, 100, 30, 0.22), inset 0 0 10px rgba(255,100,30,0.05);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .ip-showcase:active {
            transform: scale(0.98) translateY(0px);
            transition: transform 0.1s ease;
        }

        .ip-text-side { text-align: left; }

        .ip-meta {
            font-size: 0.65rem;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            color: #aaa;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        .ip-string {
            font-size: 1.15rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: #ffffff;
        }

        .copy-badge {
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            width: 38px;
            height: 38px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            transition: background 0.3s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .ip-showcase:hover .copy-badge {
            background: #b251ff;
            transform: scale(1.1) rotate(5deg);
        }

        .copy-badge svg {
            width: 18px;
            height: 18px;
            fill: #d494ff;
            transition: fill 0.3s ease;
        }

        .ip-showcase:hover .copy-badge svg { fill: #ffffff; }

        /* Toast slide-up */
        .toast-banner {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #00e87a, #00ff99);
            color: #000000;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: 1.05rem;
            transform: translateY(105%);
            transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
            border-radius: 14px;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        .toast-banner.active { transform: translateY(0); }

        /* Discord button */
        .discord-btn {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 12px;
            width: 100%;
            padding: 1.1rem;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5865F2 0%, #404eed 100%);
            color: #ffffff;
            text-decoration: none;
            border-radius: 14px;
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: 1.1rem;
            margin-top: 1rem;
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.3);
            transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s ease, filter 0.3s ease;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
            cursor: pointer;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .discord-btn::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0%, transparent 60%);
            opacity: 0;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

        .discord-btn:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 30px rgba(88, 101, 242, 0.5);
            filter: brightness(1.12);
        }

        .discord-btn:hover::after { opacity: 1; }

        .discord-btn:active {
            transform: translateY(0px) scale(0.98);
            transition: transform 0.1s ease;
        }

        .discord-btn svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: #ffffff; }

        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            h1 { font-size: 2.3rem; }
            .glass-card { padding: 2.5rem 1.25rem; }
            .logo-frame { width: 110px; height: 110px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="bg-layer"></div>
    <div class="ambient-glow"></div>
    <div class="particles" id="particles"></div>

    <div class="glass-card">
        <div class="logo-frame">
            <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="CRAFT07 Logo" class="server-logo">
        </div>

        <h1>CRAFT07</h1>
        <p class="sub-tag">Join the Ultimate Realm</p>

        <div class="section-title">
            <img class="block-emoji" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Java Icon">
            Java Edition
        </div>
        <div class="ip-showcase" onclick="copyValue('play.craft07.me', 'toast-java')">
            <div class="ip-text-side">
                <p class="ip-meta">Server IP</p>
                <p class="ip-string">play.craft07.me</p>
            </div>
            <div class="copy-badge">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M16 1H4c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14h2V3h12V1zm3 4H8c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h11c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V7c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H8V7h11v14z"/></svg>
            </div>
            <div class="toast-banner" id="toast-java">✓ Java IP Copied!</div>
        </div>

        <div class="section-title">
            <img class="block-emoji" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Bedrock Icon">
            Bedrock Edition (PE/Mobile)
        </div>
        <div class="ip-showcase" onclick="copyValue('play.craft07.me', 'toast-bedrock-ip')">
            <div class="ip-text-side">
                <p class="ip-meta">Bedrock IP</p>
                <p class="ip-string">play.craft07.me</p>
            </div>
            <div class="copy-badge">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M16 1H4c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14h2V3h12V1zm3 4H8c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h11c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V7c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H8V7h11v14z"/></svg>
            </div>
            <div class="toast-banner" id="toast-bedrock-ip">✓ Bedrock IP Copied!</div>
        </div>

        <div class="ip-showcase" onclick="copyValue('25566', 'toast-bedrock-port')">
            <div class="ip-text-side">
                <p class="ip-meta">Bedrock Port</p>
                <p class="ip-string">25566</p>
            </div>
            <div class="copy-badge">
                <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M16 1H4c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14h2V3h12V1zm3 4H8c-1.1 0-2 .9-2 2v14c0 1.1.9 2 2 2h11c1.1 0 2-.9 2-2V7c0-1.1-.9-2-2-2zm0 16H8V7h11v14z"/></svg>
            </div>
            <div class="toast-banner" id="toast-bedrock-port">✓ Port 25566 Copied!</div>
        </div>

        <button class="discord-btn" onclick="openDiscord()">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 127.14 96.36"><path d="M107.7,8.07A105.15,105.15,0,0,0,77.26,0a77.19,77.19,0,0,0-3.3,6.83A96.67,96.67,0,0,0,53.22,6.83,77.19,77.19,0,0,0,49.88,0,105.15,105.15,0,0,0,19.44,8.07C3.66,31.58-1.86,54.65,1,77.53a105.73,105.73,0,0,0,32,16.21,80.4,80.4,0,0,0,6.85-11.19,68.4,68.4,0,0,1-10.75-5.13c.91-.66,1.8-1.34,2.65-2a75.58,75.58,0,0,0,71.3,0c.85.69,1.74,1.37,2.65,2a68.4,68.4,0,0,1-10.75,5.13,80.4,80.4,0,0,0,6.85,11.19,105.73,105.73,0,0,0,32-16.21C130.66,47.55,124.5,24.73,107.7,8.07ZM42.45,65.69C36.18,65.69,31,60,31,53S36.18,40.36,42.45,40.36,53.88,46,53.79,53,48.72,65.69,42.45,65.69Zm42.24,0C78.41,65.69,73.24,60,73.24,53S78.41,40.36,84.69,40.36,96.12,46,96,53,91,65.69,84.69,65.69Z"/></svg>
            Join Discord Server
        </button>
    </div>

    <script>
        // --- Floating particles ---
        (function spawnParticles() {
            var container = document.getElementById('particles');
            var colors = ['rgba(255,120,40,0.7)', 'rgba(255,180,60,0.6)', 'rgba(200,80,255,0.5)', 'rgba(255,80,80,0.5)', 'rgba(255,200,100,0.6)'];
            for (var i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
                (function(i) {
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        var p = document.createElement('div');
                        p.className = 'particle';
                        var size = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
                        p.style.cssText = [
                            'width:' + size + 'px',
                            'height:' + size + 'px',
                            'left:' + (Math.random() * 100) + '%',
                            'bottom:-10px',
                            'background:' + colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)],
                            'animation-duration:' + (Math.random() * 8 + 6) + 's',
                            'animation-delay:' + (Math.random() * 5) + 's',
                            'box-shadow: 0 0 ' + (size * 2) + 'px ' + colors[Math.floor(Math.random() * colors.length)]
                        ].join(';');
                        container.appendChild(p);
                    }, i * 200);
                })(i);
            }
        })();

        // --- Copy to clipboard ---
        function copyValue(textVal, toastId) {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(textVal).then(function() {
                showToast(toastId);
            }).catch(function() {
                var el = document.createElement("textarea");
                document.body.appendChild(el);
                el.value = textVal;
                el.select();
                document.execCommand("copy");
                document.body.removeChild(el);
                showToast(toastId);
            });
        }

        function showToast(toastId) {
            var toast = document.getElementById(toastId);
            toast.classList.add('active');
            setTimeout(function() { toast.classList.remove('active'); }, 1600);
        }

        // --- Discord: tries app deep-link first, then falls back to web URL ---
        function openDiscord() {
            var code = 'GragT2Yecs';
            var tried = false;

            // Listen for visibility change — if tab loses focus, app opened
            function onVisChange() {
                tried = true;
            }
            document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisChange);

            // Try Discord app URI scheme
            var iframe = document.createElement('iframe');
            iframe.style.display = 'none';
            iframe.src = 'discord://-/invite/' + code;
            document.body.appendChild(iframe);

            // After 1.2s, open web fallback if the app didn't intercept
            setTimeout(function() {
                document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisChange);
                document.body.removeChild(iframe);
                if (!tried) {
                    window.open('https://discord.com/invite/' + code, '_blank');
                }
            }, 1200);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
